definition_dual_price_sampling_auction.reason: The route symmetrically offers the sample-derived threshold to the complement and the complement-derived threshold to the sample.
definition_dual_price_sampling_auction.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:417-422 is the pinned source passage for: The dual-price sampling variant offers f(B') to the complement and f(B\B') to the sample, typically with half sampling.
definition_dual_price_sampling_auction.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed joint outcome law computes each side's offer from the opposite side rather than reusing a bidder's own report.

definition_weighted_pairing_revenue.reason: The linked clauses identify W, the finite expected revenue of the genuine weighted-pairing joint outcome law, and prove that the outcome-law expectation equals W.
definition_weighted_pairing_revenue.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:621-623 is the pinned source passage for: W denotes the expected revenue of the weighted-pairing auction.
definition_weighted_pairing_revenue.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed surface exposes both quantities over the same normalized nonsingleton profile and an equality theorem connecting them.

definition_k_item_vickrey.reason: The route selects the k highest bidders and charges each winner the next bid, so the mechanism is the source k-item single-price Vickrey auction.
definition_k_item_vickrey.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:284-287 is the pinned source passage for: The k-item Vickrey auction sells to the k highest bidders at the (k+1)-st highest bid, hence is single-price.
definition_k_item_vickrey.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed outcome uses the order statistic at rank k+1 as a common payment and restricts winners to the top-k set.

model_bounded_dual_price_sampling_auctio.reason: The route implements the bounded dual-price mechanism on two equal halves, using the opposite half's capacity-adjusted threshold and an explicit even-capacity split.
model_bounded_dual_price_sampling_auctio.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:1692-1696 is the pinned source passage for: The bounded dual-price auction samples n/2 bids and uses opt_{k/2} so approximately k/2 bids are selected from each half.
model_bounded_dual_price_sampling_auctio.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed outcome law requires n = 2m and models total capacity as twice a half-capacity, bounding selections from each half accordingly.

definition_deterministic_optimal_thresho.reason: The route instantiates the bid-independent mechanism with the canonical opt(B_i) offer for each bidder, not the global opt(B) fixed-pricing rule.
definition_deterministic_optimal_thresho.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:991-1013 is the pinned source passage for: The deterministic optimal-threshold auction is the bid-independent auction with f=opt and offers bidder i opt(B_i), unlike optimal fixed pricing's opt(B).
definition_deterministic_optimal_thresho.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed auction removes each bidder before computing the attained optimal threshold and then applies the bid-independent outcome recipe.

definition_auction_correctness.reason: Each linked clause defines correctness as the conjunction of the corresponding truthfulness condition and individual rationality for every realized winner. Randomized clauses are credited only on the documented discrete, countably supported PMF domain GHW01-RANDOMIZED-AUCTION-PMF-DOMAIN-01; no coverage of continuous outcome laws is claimed.
definition_auction_correctness.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:79-83 is the pinned source passage for: An auction is correct exactly when it is truthful and fills every winning bid at or below that bidder's bid value.
definition_auction_correctness.dashboard_evidence: The deterministic route uses realized truthfulness; the randomized route uses expected truthfulness and requires every supported outcome to charge winners at most their bids. Randomized clauses are credited only on the documented discrete, countably supported PMF domain GHW01-RANDOMIZED-AUCTION-PMF-DOMAIN-01; no coverage of continuous outcome laws is claimed.

definition_bidder_profit.reason: The route gives utility minus payment to a winning bidder and zero to a losing bidder, preserving both branches of the source profit definition.
definition_bidder_profit.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:215-218 is the pinned source passage for: A winning bidder's profit is utility minus payment, while a losing bidder's profit is zero.
definition_bidder_profit.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed function branches on allocation and subtracts the winner's own payment only in the allocated branch.

definition_exact_half_optimal_threshold.reason: The route uses a uniform sample containing exactly n/2 bidders, computes opt on that sample, and applies the resulting threshold to the complement.
definition_exact_half_optimal_threshold.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:455-465 is the pinned source passage for: The random-sampling optimal-threshold auction samples exactly n/2 bids, computes opt on that sample, and accepts non-sample bids above the resulting threshold at that price.
definition_exact_half_optimal_threshold.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed mechanism requires n=2m with m>0 and composes the exact-half law with the optimal-threshold directional outcome recipe.

definition_weighted_pairing_auction.reason: The route samples bidder i's comparison bid from B_i with probability proportional to that bid divided by T-b_i, accepts exactly when the sampled bid is at most b_i, and charges the sampled bid.
definition_weighted_pairing_auction.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:495-508 is the pinned source passage for: The weighted-pairing auction samples an other bid b from B_i proportional to b/(T-b_i), accepts bidder i exactly when b <= b_i, and charges b.
definition_weighted_pairing_auction.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed genuine joint outcome law uses normalized nonsingleton profiles, the other-bid weighted distribution, and the source allocation/payment rule.

definition_bounded_supply_top_k_total.reason: The route realizes T_k as the greatest total value obtainable from exactly k bidders, equivalently the sum of the k highest bids on the stated capacity domain.
definition_bounded_supply_top_k_total.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:1629-1631 is the pinned source passage for: T_k is optimal multi-price revenue restricted to satisfying k bidders, equivalently the sum of the highest k bids.
definition_bounded_supply_top_k_total.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed definition optimizes the sum over k-element bidder subsets and requires k not to exceed the bidder count.

model_bounded_single_price_sampling_auct.reason: The route implements uniform fixed-size sampling, computes the supply-adjusted optimal threshold from the sample, and enforces the capacity bound with the paper's explicit floor and rejection conventions.
model_bounded_single_price_sampling_auct.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:1679-1690 is the pinned source passage for: The bounded single-price sampling auction applies the supply-adjusted optimal threshold to an m-bid sample and rejects excess accepted bids until at most k remain.
model_bounded_single_price_sampling_auct.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed outcome law requires 0 < m < n, uses the sampled threshold with floor(m*k/(n-m)), and resolves excess acceptances without exceeding k.

definition_bid_independent_auction.reason: The six linked clauses jointly remove bidder i, compute an offer only from B_i, apply the permitted weak-or-strict threshold boundary, and make i win and pay that offer exactly when the test passes.
definition_bid_independent_auction.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:351-357 is the pinned source passage for: A bid-independent auction offers bidder i the price f(B_i), determined only by other bids, and accepts exactly when the returned threshold's weak-or-strict boundary test holds (the main text uses b_i >= f(B_i), while the footnote also permits b_i > f(B_i)).
definition_bid_independent_auction.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed carrier and outcome law separate other-bid input from i's report and expose every step from offer construction through the induced deterministic mechanism.

definition_truthfulness.reason: The deterministic and randomized clauses both hold other reports fixed and compare truthful reporting with every alternative own report; the former compares realized profit and the latter finite expected profit. Randomized clauses are credited only on the documented discrete, countably supported PMF domain GHW01-RANDOMIZED-AUCTION-PMF-DOMAIN-01; no coverage of continuous outcome laws is claimed.
definition_truthfulness.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:215-222 is the pinned source passage for: An auction is truthful when bidding utility is a dominant strategy: with other bids fixed, truthful bidding maximizes realized or expected profit.
definition_truthfulness.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed predicates quantify the bidder and alternative report, update only that coordinate, and state the correct weak utility inequality in the realized and expected settings. Randomized clauses are credited only on the documented discrete, countably supported PMF domain GHW01-RANDOMIZED-AUCTION-PMF-DOMAIN-01; no coverage of continuous outcome laws is claimed.

definition_random_sampling_auction.reason: The route samples independently of bid values, computes the threshold from the sample, and offers it only to the nonsampled bidders.
definition_random_sampling_auction.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:410-416 is the pinned source passage for: A random-sampling auction selects a bid-value-independent sample B', computes f(B'), and offers that threshold to the non-sample.
definition_random_sampling_auction.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed plan separates the sample law and sample-only rule input from the directional outcome law on the complement.

result_theorem7_2_lower_bound.reason: The reviewed target adds h >= 2 to the source's F >= 2h regime, retains the normalized attained-highest-bid model, and proves the direct canonical weighted-pairing revenue bound F <= 2304 sqrt(log_2(h)) W. result_theorem7_2_lower_bound.dashboard_evidence: The theorem makes the F condition, h domain, profile conditions, direct source-defined W, and explicit coefficient visible.

definition_fixed_price_benchmark.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed definition computes fixed-price revenue at every candidate bid price and takes the finite maximum.

definition_fixed_pricing.source_evidence: GHW01DigitalGoods.txt:97-103 is the pinned source passage for: Fixed pricing posts one estimated price, while optimal fixed pricing chooses the price that maximizes fixed-price revenue when consumer utilities are known.
definition_fixed_pricing.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed outcome accepts exactly bids weakly above p and charges p; the remaining routes lift that recipe to a mechanism, compute its revenue and maximum value, and select an attaining candidate price.

definition_scarce_supply.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed predicate existentially supplies a capacity-filling optimal threshold for each of the two capacities rather than forcing one common optimizer.

definition_bid_extrema.reason: The linked clauses expose the actual minimum and maximum bid values and separately state the normalization that the minimum equals one.

definition_optimal_threshold.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed partition covers candidate membership, benchmark attainment, allocation/payment behavior, and mechanism-level application without using a caller-supplied optimum premise.

definition_auction_mechanisms.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed function types preserve the source input and outcome domains and distinguish a realized outcome from a distribution over outcomes. definition_bounded_supply_optimal_thresh.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed definition is paired with the relational optimal-threshold predicate and the attainment theorem for the bounded benchmark.

definition_bounded_supply_fixed_price_be.dashboard_evidence: The reviewed definition maximizes the capacity-capped fixed-price revenue over the finite bid-price candidates.
